_note: Vetted MCP connectors (fold-node/research/connectors/A-mcp-catalogue.md, 2026-09-06). Tier 0 = official reference servers · 1 = single-purpose, permissive licence, keyless or static key · 2 = touches a real account (warning banner, never default). OAuth-only services are NOT here on purpose: the client has no browser flow, so listing them would be a dead end — see 'locked' for the honest alternative. argv is a code-owned template array; {ROOT}-style tokens are filled at add time, never at run time; key_env names an env var the user exports, never a secret.

connectors.name: fetch
connectors.leaves: the URL you fetch, to that site
connectors.what: fetch a web page as clean text (official reference server)

connectors.name: duckduckgo
connectors.what: keyless web search as an MCP tool

connectors.name: arxiv
connectors.leaves: paper ids/queries to arXiv; PDFs cached locally
connectors.what: search + read arXiv papers, cached on disk

connectors.name: pdf
connectors.what: text/tables/OCR from local PDFs — bank statements, invoices; nothing leaves the device

connectors.name: git
connectors.what: git status/diff/log/commit on a local repo (official)

connectors.name: filesystem
connectors.leaves: nothing — the folder you allow only
connectors.what: read/write files under ONE folder you choose (never your whole home)
connectors.warn: npx fetches and runs npm code at first launch

connectors.name: memory
connectors.what: entity/relation memory graph (your /memory + /kb already cover most of this)
connectors.warn: npx fetches and runs npm code at first launch

connectors.name: sheets
connectors.key_kind: service-account JSON path (env var, no browser)
connectors.leaves: sheet cells ↔ Google's servers (same as using Sheets)
connectors.what: read/write Google Sheets via a service account
connectors.warn: touches a real Google account; the credential is inherited by the child process, not sent as a header

connectors.name: github
connectors.leaves: issues/PRs/repo content ↔ GitHub (already your data there)

install.termux: binary release from the repo (Go); no pkg

connectors.what: issues, PRs, repo search on GitHub with a PAT
connectors.warn: a PAT can write to your repos — scope it to what you need

connectors.name: email
connectors.leaves: mail content ↔ your own IMAP/SMTP host
connectors.what: read/send mail over IMAP/SMTP with an app password
connectors.warn: real inbox access; for client-facing mail this needs the owner's compliance call first

connectors.name: homeassistant
connectors.leaves: device state/commands ↔ your own Home Assistant
connectors.what: lights, switches, sensors through your own Home Assistant
connectors.warn: only if you actually run Home Assistant

locked.notion: Notion's MCP is OAuth-only — this client has no browser flow. Local alternative: keep notes as Markdown in ~/ai-vault (/remember, /kb) or point the filesystem connector at your notes folder.
locked.canva: Canva's connector is OAuth-only. Local alternative: /agent chitrakar for prompts + /do image_generation (keyless).
locked.google calendar: Every Calendar server found is OAuth-only. Local alternative: 'remind me in 10 min' (timer hand on Linux, notification on Android) and a plain list: 'todo: …'.
locked.calendar: OAuth-only everywhere. Local alternative: reminders via hands + lists (/list).
locked.google photos: Google Photos API is OAuth-only for personal libraries. Local alternative: /attach a photo, or the filesystem connector on a synced folder.
locked.whatsapp: The only real WhatsApp MCP needs a Go bridge (no Termux package) and links your account like WhatsApp Web; for client messaging it is also a ToS/AMFI exposure. Local alternative: 'whatsapp <number>: <text>' opens a prefilled chat, nothing is sent by the program.
locked.todoist: Licence could not be verified. Local alternative: the built-in lists ('todo: buy milk', 'list dikhao').
